company_name: Linde LienHwa Industrial Gases Co., Ltd.
semiconductor_relevance: High — Linde LienHwa is a leading supplier of high purity gases and chemicals specifically for the semiconductor and electronics industries.
summary: Linde LienHwa Industrial Gases Co., Ltd. specializes in providing electronic-grade gases and chemicals essential for semiconductor manufacturing. With over 100 years of expertise in gas production, they ensure high purity and consistent supply for critical processes in silicon and compound semiconductor industries.
capabilities: High purity process gases for semiconductor fabrication
Gas pipeline design and construction services
Logistics and stocking capabilities for gas supply
technical_expertise: Supply chain logistics for industrial gases

regional_presence.Taiwan: Linde operates as BOCLH and AUECC in Taiwan, serving the semiconductor industry with a focus on high purity gases.
